title: Component Inner Products and Dual Space Definitions
starting_point: V1691.0 required exact component inner products and dual/cotangent spaces before deriving adjoint boundary maps.
goal: Define V_G, V_G*, component inner products, and admissible dual covectors for B, op_plus, O3, H4_perp, S, and Pi.
claim_boundary: Mathematical definition only. No execution, no law validation.

local_algebra.primal_space: V_G(p) = V_B(p) ⊕ V_oplus(p) ⊕ V_O3(p) ⊕ V_H4(p) ⊕ V_S(p) ⊕ V_Pi(p)
local_algebra.dual_space: V_G*(p) = V_B*(p) ⊕ V_oplus*(p) ⊕ V_O3*(p) ⊕ V_H4*(p) ⊕ V_S*(p) ⊕ V_Pi*(p)
local_algebra.generator_space: A_pq ∈ End_R(G_p,G_q), an admissible generated-algebra derivation/connection generator

V_B.primal: matrix/frame variations ΔB with same branch index structure as B_p
V_B.weight: W_B positive semidefinite, observable branch-confidence / retained mass weighting
V_B.dual: V_B* identified by W_B-weighted covectors C_B where C_B(X)=tr(C_B^T W_B X)

V_oplus.primal: bilinear product residual maps K: V_B × V_B -> V_B
V_oplus.weight: T_p is a retained test-pair set from generators/O3/H4/source directions; ω_ab are observable pair weights
V_oplus.dual: V_oplus* consists of weighted bilinear covectors over retained test pairs

V_O3.weight: W_O3 from retained associator scale/provenance confidence
V_O3.dual: O3 covectors identified by W_O3-weighted vectors

V_H4.primal: H4_perp variations in quotient Q_H4 = V / span(B,O3)
V_H4.weight: W_H4 positive semidefinite on quotient/perpendicular residual direction
V_H4.dual: V_H4* consists only of covectors annihilating span(B,O3)

V_S.weight: W_S from source mass/access confidence; must be independent of E residual

V_Pi.inner_product: <P,Q>_Pi = Σ_{e∈Pi} ω_e P_e Q_e + Σ_{paths} ω_path P_path Q_path
V_Pi.weight: dependency/event weights from ledger confidence, ordered-index validity, and source provenance

global_inner_product.rule: weights w_k must be declared before stationarity and cannot be tuned using compatibility residuals.

generator_inner_product.W_A: W_A induced from the component action of A on V_G, or identity as a minimal scaffold until exact induced metric is derived.
generator_inner_product.rule: same W_A must be used for gradients, stationarity, and boundary adjoints.

dual_admissibility.B_dual: must act only on retained branch-frame variations
dual_admissibility.oplus_dual: must act on retained product test pairs, not arbitrary dense pairs unless declared
dual_admissibility.S_dual: must be independent of post-hoc residuals

component_identity_target.general: For every component k, D_Gamma R_Gamma^k ∈ V_k* and rho_P^k + Q_A^k ∈ V_k*.
component_identity_target.meaning: component equality is dual-space equality, not scalar norm similarity.

forbidden: component projections chosen after seeing null performance
component weights tuned to lower E_stress
H4 covectors that do not annihilate span(B,O3)
Pi covectors that ignore retained-order orientation
event-label assignment used as substitute for dual derivation
